items.title: Walter Booker and Jimmy Cobb interviewed by Michael Woods, Majesty of the Seas, May 30, 1995
items.q: Yeah he played melodic lines, but in harmony within what the changes are. Plus he played great solos huh?

ctx.x: Yeah ‘cause he’s the one who kind of modernized that bass playing, because before then they was playing [scats], like two beat notes. He kind of started to play the chord and walk changes.
Yeah he played melodic lines, but in harmony within what the changes are. Plus he played great solos huh?
